segments.Management Opening Statement: Ladies and gentlemen, we are pleased to report a strong quarter with record revenues and expanded margins.
segments.Financial Highlights: Revenue grew by 16% year-over-year. EBITDA margins improved by 200 basis points.
segments.Outlook & Guidance: Looking ahead, we expect this momentum to continue. We are raising our full year guidance.
segments.Q&A Session: Analyst: Great quarter. Are you seeing any demand softness? Mgmt: No, demand remains robust across all verticals.
